summary: An arrow function has no own arguments binding; references resolve to the enclosing function's arguments binding.

target.notes: Capture the enclosing lowered arguments object/cell. Do not synthesize a new arguments array for the arrow.

caveats: At top level there may be no arguments binding.
If enclosing arguments is a mapped arguments exotic object, capture that object rather than a copy.

tests.name: arrow call arguments do not replace outer arguments
tests.input: function f(x){ const g=()=>arguments.length; return g(1,2,3); } console.log(f(9));
